notes: Intended for Sepolia. LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. TipJar accepts positive ETH tips with optional valid UTF-8 messages of at most 140 Unicode scalar values and charges no application fees. Its sole constructor argument, $owner, resolves from policy and sets the immutable withdrawal authority and recipient of the whole balance. Both constructors are nonpayable and fully configure their contracts; no initialization calls are needed. The factory supplies liquidity, MerkleDistributor and PoolInitializationGuard. Policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services. Independent review precedes service admission and deployment.
